# couchbase-capella_replication (Resource)

This resource allows you to manage an XDCR replication from a bucket in an operational cluster to a bucket in another cluster.

**Some changes replace the replication.** A change to `source_bucket`, `target` (including `target.type`) or `direction` cannot be applied in place, so Terraform deletes the replication and creates a new one.

**Turning off a cluster removes its replications.** When the source or target cluster is turned off, Capella deletes the replication on both clusters. The next `terraform plan` then shows the replication as a new resource to create.

**Two-way replications and App Services.** To create an App Service on either cluster of a `twoWay` replication, `mobile_sync_mode` must be `active`. Otherwise, Capella does not allow the App Service to be created.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "couchbase-capella_replication" "new_replication" {
  organization_id = "ffffffff-aaaa-1414-eeee-000000000000"
  project_id      = "ffffffff-aaaa-1414-eeee-000000000000"
  cluster_id      = "ffffffff-aaaa-1414-eeee-000000000000"
  source_bucket   = "dHJhdmVsLXNhbXBsZQ=="

  target = {
    cluster = "aaaaaaaa-bbbb-1414-eeee-000000000000"
    bucket  = "dHJhdmVsLXNhbXBsZQ=="
  }

  direction           = "oneWay"
  priority            = "high"
  network_usage_limit = 0

  mappings = [
    {
      source_scope = "inventory"
      target_scope = "inventory"
      collections = [
        { source_collection = "airline", target_collection = "airline" },
      ]
    },
  ]

  filter = {
    document_exclude_options = {
      deletion = false
      ttl      = true
    }
    expressions = {
      reg_ex = "REGEXP_CONTAINS(META().id, '^airline_')"
    }
  }
}

# Mobile sync mode and conflict logging. Both need cross cluster versioning on the source and
# target buckets. A create with mobile_sync_mode = "active" turns cross cluster versioning on.
# Conflict logging needs Couchbase Server 8.0 or later.
resource "couchbase-capella_replication" "mobile_replication" {
  organization_id = "ffffffff-aaaa-1414-eeee-000000000000"
  project_id      = "ffffffff-aaaa-1414-eeee-000000000000"
  cluster_id      = "ffffffff-aaaa-1414-eeee-000000000000"
  source_bucket   = "dHJhdmVsLXNhbXBsZQ=="

  target = {
    cluster = "aaaaaaaa-bbbb-1414-eeee-000000000000"
    bucket  = "dHJhdmVsLXNhbXBsZQ=="
  }

  mobile_sync_mode = "active"

  conflict_logging = {
    disabled   = false
    bucket     = "Y29uZmxpY3Rsb2dz"
    collection = "logs.default"

    logging_rules = {
      "inventory"       = { bucket = "Y29uZmxpY3Rsb2dz", collection = "logs.inventory" } # log to this target
      "sales"           = {}                                                             # log to the default
      "agents.partners" = null                                                           # do not log
    }
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the cluster.
- `organization_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the organization.
- `project_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the project.
- `source_bucket` (String) - The ID of the source bucket.
- `target` (Attributes) - Target contains all the metadata about a replication target. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--target))

### Optional

- `conflict_logging` (Attributes) - Conflict logging. It needs Couchbase Server 8.0 or later and cross cluster versioning on both buckets. Removing it clears the configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--conflict_logging))
- `direction` (String) - Direction specifies the replication flow — whether it's oneWay (source to target only) or twoWay (also from target back to source).
 - **Valid Values**: `oneWay`, `twoWay`
 - **Default**: `oneWay`
- `filter` (Attributes) - Filter contains the replication settings which are passed to the Couchbase server API while creating a replication. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter))
- `mappings` (Attributes Set) - Defines mappings from source to target scopes and collections. This field is only required if you are replicating specific scopes and collections. Note: If the collections array is empty or omitted, it implies all collections under that scope would be replicated. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mappings))
- `mobile_sync_mode` (String) - Set to `active` so that App Services can run on both the source and the target. `active` needs cross cluster versioning on both buckets. A create with `active` turns on cross cluster versioning, which cannot be turned off. An update does not.
- `network_usage_limit` (Number) - Network usage limit in MiB per second. 0 means unlimited.
 - **Default**: `0`
- `priority` (String) - Priority represents the resource allocation to the replication. low: Resource constraints are applied when competing with high priority replications medium: Resource constraints are applied during initial processing when competing with high priority replications, then operates as high priority high: No resource constraints are applied (default priority)
 - **Valid Values**: `low`, `medium`, `high`
 - **Default**: `high`

### Read-Only

- `audit` (Attributes) Couchbase audit data. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--audit))
- `changes_left` (Number) - The number of remaining mutations to the replication.
- `error` (String) - The error message if the replication has failed.
- `id` (String) - The ID of the specified replication.
- `reverse_replication_id` (String) - The ID of the replication from target to source. This field is only present for twoWay replications.
- `source_details` (Attributes) - Details of the source of the replication, as returned by the API. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--source_details))
- `status` (String) - The status of the replication.
 - **Valid Values**: `pending`, `pausing`, `failed`, `paused`, `running`
- `target_details` (Attributes) - Details of the target of the replication, as returned by the API. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--target_details))

<a id="nestedatt--target"></a>
### Nested Schema for `target`

Required:

- `bucket` (String) - The target bucket identifier. For Capella buckets, use bucket ID For external clusters, use bucket name
- `cluster` (String) - The target cluster identifier. For Capella clusters, use cluster ID For external clusters, use cluster reference name

Optional:

- `type` (String) - Type tells us if the target cluster is capella or external.
 - **Valid Values**: `capella`, `external`
 - **Default**: `capella`


<a id="nestedatt--conflict_logging"></a>
### Nested Schema for `conflict_logging`

Required:

- `bucket` (String) - The ID of the log bucket. It can be empty only when `disabled` is true.
- `collection` (String) - The default log collection, as `scope.collection`. It can be empty only when `disabled` is true.
- `disabled` (Boolean) - Set to true to keep the configuration without logging conflicts.

Optional:

- `logging_rules` (Attributes Map) - Log targets for a source scope or `scope.collection`. A rule with `bucket` and `collection` logs there, `{}` logs to the default, and `null` does not log. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--conflict_logging--logging_rules))

<a id="nestedatt--conflict_logging--logging_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `conflict_logging.logging_rules`

Optional:

- `bucket` (String) - The ID of the log bucket for this rule. Set it with `collection`.
- `collection` (String) - The log collection for this rule, as `scope.collection`. Set it with `bucket`.



<a id="nestedatt--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Optional:

- `document_exclude_options` (Attributes) - The kinds of document change that are not replicated. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter--document_exclude_options))
- `expressions` (Attributes) - The filter expression. Only documents that match it are replicated. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter--expressions))

<a id="nestedatt--filter--document_exclude_options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter.document_exclude_options`

Optional:

- `binary` (Boolean) - When true, binary documents are filtered.
 - **Default**: `false`
- `deletion` (Boolean) - When true, deletions are filtered out.
 - **Default**: `false`
- `expiration` (Boolean) - When true, expirations are filtered out.
 - **Default**: `false`
- `ttl` (Boolean) - When true, TTL value is removed from the replicated documents.
 - **Default**: `false`


<a id="nestedatt--filter--expressions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter.expressions`

Required:

- `reg_ex` (String) - Filter expression to match documents.

Optional:

- `skip_restream` (Boolean) - If true, updated filter applies only to new mutations. If false, replication restarts with updated filter.
 - **Default**: `false`



<a id="nestedatt--mappings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `mappings`

Required:

- `source_scope` (String) - The name of the scope in the source bucket.
- `target_scope` (String) - The name of the scope in the target bucket.

Optional:

- `collections` (Attributes Set) - The collections to replicate from the source scope. When omitted, all collections in the scope are replicated. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mappings--collections))

<a id="nestedatt--mappings--collections"></a>
### Nested Schema for `mappings.collections`

Required:

- `source_collection` (String) - The name of the collection in the source scope.
- `target_collection` (String) - The name of the collection in the target scope.



<a id="nestedatt--audit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `audit`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) - The RFC3339 timestamp associated with when the replication was initially created.
 - **Format**: Date-time in RFC3339 format
- `created_by` (String) - The user who created the replication; this will be a UUID4 ID for standard users and will be a string such as "internal-support" for internal Couchbase support users.

- `project` (Attributes) - Project contains the metadata for the source from which the replication is established. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--source_details--project))

- `cluster` (Attributes) - Cluster contains the metadata for the destination to which the replication is established. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--target_details--cluster))
- `project` (Attributes) - Project contains the metadata for the destination to which the replication is established. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--target_details--project))
- `type` (String) - Type tells us if the target cluster is capella or external.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import couchbase-capella_replication.new_replication id=<replication_id>,cluster_id=<cluster_id>,project_id=<project_id>,organization_id=<organization_id>
```
